README: The seeded aircraft directory. DATA, not code: adding an airframe is an edit
to this file, not a component change.
EVERY figure here was read off the manufacturer's own specification page on
the date in `verified`, and `source` is the page it came from. A figure the
manufacturer does not publish is null. It is never inferred from a model
number, a predecessor, or a dealer listing: DJI's T10 carries 8 L while its
T16 carries a number DJI no longer publishes at all, so the numbering does
not decode, and a capacity guessed off a name would be a fabricated value
swath_m is a DEFAULT the operator confirms, not a fact about the airframe.
Effective swath depends on altitude, speed, nozzle and wind, which is why
the makers publish a range rather than a number. Where a maker publishes a
single operating figure it is used; where they publish a range, swath_m is
null and swath_published_m carries the range, so the operator sets the width
they actually fly instead of inheriting one we invented for them.
See src/lib/aircraftDirectory.ts for the schema and src/lib/droneSpecs.ts for
how these entries become planner specs.

Spray width 7 m quoted at 2.5 m relative altitude and 6.5 m/s. Flow 6 L/min per sprinkler, two fitted.

Spray width 11 m quoted at 2.5 m relative altitude and 7 m/s. SwathWise plans this airframe at 9 m; see PLANNING_PROFILES in droneSpecs.ts for why the shipped default is narrower than the published figure.
Spray width 4-11 m at 3 m above the crop. Flow 16 L/min with 2 sprinklers, 24 L/min with 4.
Spray width 4-11 m. Flow 40 L/min with the standard 2 nozzles, 50 L/min with the optional 4.
Spray width 4-11 m. Flow 30 L/min with the standard 2 sprays, 40 L/min with the optional 4.
Spray width 5-13 m. Flow 30 L/min with the standard 2 nozzles, 40 L/min with the optional 4. The 150 L figure DJI also quotes is the spreading payload; 100 L is the spray tank.
XAG publishes the 5-10 m width as a tested value across operating heights and wind speeds, for reference only. Flow 5 L/min per pump, two fitted.

80 L rated capacity. Flow 32 L/min across dual pumps.

Superseded by the AG-216. Specification no longer published by Hylio; see the AG-110 note.
5.2 US gal (20 L) as a dual tank, 2.6 gal each side. Swath up to 30 ft (9.1 m).

2.6 US gal (10 L), swath up to 20 ft (6.1 m).
4.2 US gal (16 L), swath up to 25 ft (7.6 m).
8.0 US gal (30 L), swath up to 35 ft (10.7 m).
18.0 US gal (68 L) across a dual tank, swath up to 40 ft (12.2 m).
13 US gal (50 L) liquid. The 20-21 gal (76 L) figure Hylio also quotes is the granular spreader hopper, not the spray tank. Swath up to 40 ft (12.2 m).
Hylio lists PEGASUS in 2.5 and 4 US gal configurations (roughly 9.5 and 15 L) without naming a standard, and publishes no swath. Left blank so the operator states the configuration they own.
Hylio lists ATLAS in 30 and 45 US gal configurations (roughly 114 and 170 L) without naming a default, and publishes no swath. Left blank for the operator.
